text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
Hand over the ticket.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: An offering for my child.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall take my rest.
—At a hot spring."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened at the beginning of the Senior Year. With a raffle ticket she got from a child, Orfevre won a voucher for a hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She said she would tell me when the time came...
It seems that day has suddenly arrived."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...
How charming."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
carry the luggage.
choice_data_list: ...Huh, come to think of it, where are your vassals?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Whether I keep company or scatter them is entirely at my whim.
Right now, I need no one.
choice_data_list: ...Hm? But I'm right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You may go.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A staff is not a person, is it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I am taking a bath.
...Do not disturb me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having taken a long bath, Orfevre looked slightly sleepy. Her usual commanding aura was somewhat subdued as well...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How unpleasant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I hurried to chase after Orfevre, an idea suddenly struck me.
Could I head off where she's likely to go in advance?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why are you here?
choice_data_list: I tried to imagine what you were thinking.
I tried thinking about what you might be thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre seemed a bit spaced out.
If so, she'd probably want some fresh air...
It looks like my intuition was spot on.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tch.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that smirk off your face.
It's only making me more irritated.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At times, Orfevre is impossible to decipher.
That's why I seek perspectives I don't possess...
thinking endlessly, searching far and wide—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When you do that, before you know it...
you learn things you never knew, yearn for so much more,
and see sights you never could have reached alone.
choice_data_list: I'm so happy to be able to serve you.
I'm happy to be in your service.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I care nothing
for your happiness.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It's hot.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
—Hold out your hands.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Just do it.
Hand it over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Doing as told, I hold out my hand before Orfevre...
and then, she—
rubs her cheek against the back of my hand, just like a cat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk, it's hot. Cool it down, quickly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Then until it cools...
do not move. —That is a royal decree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between Orfevre and myself...
